name: ST Nucleo-F401RE
description: ST Nucleo-64 board with the STM32F401RET6 (84 MHz Cortex-M4F, 512 KB flash, 96 KB RAM) and an on-board ST-LINK, at 3.3 V logic, programmed with STM32duino (Arduino). Runs real firmware in Renode (local Docker). Only the Arduino Uno headers are drawn (D0-D15, A0-A5) plus PC13; pin ids are the chip's port pins (D13 = PA5). Serial = USART2 on D1 / D0 (PA2 / PA3, also over the ST-LINK USB), Wire = D14 / D15 (PB9 / PB8), SPI = D11 / D12 / D13 (SS D10), green LED LD2 on D13, user button B1 on PC13.

availability.reason: Its fixture test does not pass yet: the firmware boots and every listed pin works as an output and an input, Wire, SPI, analogRead, analogWrite and Serial work, but attachInterrupt never fires on this board in Renode (tried PA8, PA10, PB5; the Black Pill F411 on the same platform works; cause not found).
